title: Ana Ribeiro — CV
text:
Summary
Backend engineer building event-driven services in Python.

Experience
Senior Backend Engineer, Parcelo (2021-2026): designed Kafka-based order event pipelines processing 40k events per second; led migration of a monolith to FastAPI microservices on AWS ECS; owned PostgreSQL schema design and on-call.
Backend Engineer, Shopwise (2018-2021): built REST APIs in Python and Django, introduced integration testing.

Education
BSc Computer Science, University of Porto.

Skills
Python, FastAPI, Django, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS), Docker, Terraform

dossier.cover_letter: I build event-driven backends. At Parcelo I designed Kafka order pipelines and led our move to FastAPI on ECS; I'd like to bring that to Northwind's logistics platform.

linkedin.headline: Senior Backend Engineer · Kafka, Python, AWS
linkedin.about: Backend engineer focused on event-driven systems and reliable on-call.
